learning_outcomes.text: Basic practical skills of work with advanced CAD/CAE/CAM systems.
Knowledge improvement in basic tasks of kinetostatics and dynamics and their applications in individual task.
Common principles of engine and vehicle design.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of work with CAD/CAE/CAM systems Creo or Catia V5 (introduction to part solid modeling, creating of assembly and drawing, using CAE capabilities)
Ordinary differential equations a solving methods
Common design principles and similar criterions
